name: Right Bank

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Sémillon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Sémillon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
